info.description:
## Monkspaces Shared Product & Packaging Data Platform API

An enterprise-grade, multi-tenant SaaS API for collecting, normalising, governing, and calculating compliance liabilities across national EPR regulations (UK Defra RPD, CITEO, VerpackG) and future EU PPWR / Digital Product Passport requirements.

### Architecture Highlights:
- **Layer 1 Canonical Foundation:** Master products, BOM tree, and sales placed on market.
- **Layer 2 Data Quality:** Financial liability exposure (€ at risk) and source correction workflow.
- **Layer 3 EPR Compliance:** Reproducible calculation runs with line-item formula explainability.
- **Strict Multi-Tenancy:** Scoped by `X-Tenant-ID` header with consultant workspace isolation.
info.title: Monkspaces Shared Data Platform API
